'''Gennadii Shlemovich Rubinstein''' ([[Russian language|Russian]]: Геннадий Шлемович Рубинштейн) was a [[Russians|Russian]] [[mathematician]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?option_lang=eng&personid=22231 |title=Rubinshtein, Gennadii Shlemovich |website=Persons |location=Math-Net.ru |access-date=2021-11-27}}</ref> His research focused on [[mathematical programming]] and [[operations research]]. His name is associated to the '''[[Leonid Kantorovich|Kantorovich]]–Rubinstein metric''', also commonly known as the '''[[Leonid Vaseršteĭn|Wasserstein]] distance''', used in optimal transport.

* Alternate form of the first name: Gennady.
* Alternate forms of the last name: Rubinšteĭn, Rubinshtein.

==Doctorate==
Gennadii Rubinstein got his [[doctorate]] in [[St. Petersburg State University]] in 1956, under the supervision of [[Leonid Kantorovich|Leonid V. Kantorovich]].
